subject: FY25 Preliminary Budget Hearings
overview: The Committee of the Whole held its third preliminary review of the Fiscal Year 2025 budget, hearing presentations from the Recreation Department, Hormel Stadium Commission, Executive Department, and Licensing Commission. Discussions focused on department narratives, staffing requests, and facility maintenance.

items.title: Recreation Department
items.summary: Director Kevin Bailey presented a $312,685 budget, highlighting a request for an office manager, the establishment of a 501(c)(3) support board, and a new initiative to provide free swim lessons.

items.title: Energy Assessment and Staffing Motions
items.summary: The committee referred motions to the administration to request an energy assessment for solar panels at the Hormel Stadium parking lot and to consider creating a split administrative position to support the Recreation Department.

items.title: Hormel Stadium Commission
items.summary: Director Kevin Bailey reported a level-funded budget while noting ongoing efforts with the DPW to repair the press box to prevent animal intrusions and plans to address the stadium's sound quality.

items.title: Executive Department
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian presented a $667,696 budget, detailing successes including the MSBA high school application, the city's Double A Plus bond rating, and the filling of several department head vacancies.

items.title: Licensing Commission
items.summary: The committee reviewed the level-funded $5,800 budget for the commission, which primarily covers member stipends and office supplies.
